name: "Spinach Dip" Flatbread with Artichokes, Sun-Dried Tomatoes & Basil

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the basil along with cottage cheese and spices. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 cups cottage cheese
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, then add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, about 1 minute, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.

Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and add to the bowl with the cottage cheese mixture. Stir to combine the spinach dip and set aside.
Peel and mince shallots. Place on a plate.
Drain and thinly slice sun-dried tomatoes and artichoke hearts. Add both to the plate with the shallot.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Divide flatbreads between two large baking sheet pans. Spread with spinach dip, then top with cheese, sun-dried tomatoes, artichoke hearts, and shallots.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until flatbreads are lightly crispy and cheese is melted, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
To serve, cut flatbreads into wedges and divide between plates. Enjoy!
